description: This Python source file implements a DualCache class that synchronously updates and retrieves data from both Redis and an in-memory cache, with support for asynchronous operations, batch processing, TTL management, and cache invalidation. It provides a dual-layer caching mechanism to optimize data access in a distributed environment.

classes.name: LimitedSizeOrderedDict
classes.description: An OrderedDict subclass that enforces a maximum size by removing the oldest item when a new item exceeds the size limit.

classes.name: DualCache
classes.description: A cache class that maintains synchronization between Redis and an in-memory cache, supporting synchronous and asynchronous operations, batch processing, TTL management, and cache invalidation.
